مَاذِىٌّ (K) and مَاذِيَّةٌ (S, L, Msb, K) A soft coat of mail, easy to the wearer; (S, L, Msb, K;) and [so] the former, any weapon: (K:) or the latter, a white coat of mail. (Msb.) ―
-b2- Hence, (Msb,) the latter, White honey: (S, L, Msb, K:) or [in the CK and] new honey: or pure honey: or excellent honey. (K.) ―
-b3- Also, the latter, Wine. (S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
